---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to the DI-CC codebase or documentation
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A clear, concise description of what you'd like to see added or changed.

## Motivation

What problem does this solve, or what use case does it enable? (e.g.
reproducing the paper on a different decomposer scale, running on CPU,
extending the pipeline to a new dataset.)

## Proposed Approach

If you have one in mind, describe how you'd implement this. Note whether
your proposal would change any script's reproducible output (see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) — changes to core methodology are
evaluated more carefully since this repo exists to reproduce specific
published results).

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you considered, and why you didn't choose them.

## Additional Context

Anything else relevant — links, references, screenshots, etc.
